# DR-1281: Nobody is coming to define your work (mgmt9) — the steward who waits for a definition, and a lesson that stakes no number

**Date:** 2026-10-29
**Status:** Accepted
**Tier:** A (additive curriculum: one new Real Estate lesson with its own pinned gate; the course's `meta.weeks` follows its own module count; two generated files re-derived by their own scripts; the counted honesty gap raised by one with a reason and a date)
**Type:** curriculum
**Area:** Learn · Management Is Stewardship (`app/src/lib/management-stewardship-course.js`)
**Sent in by:** Darrell, Gmail thread `1a11253cf17a2bdf` — a SmartBrief for the Higher Ed Leader edition of 5 October 2026, "Higher ed.'s next chance to shape history: AI literacy and the workforce", forwarded to himself on 6 October with one word at the top of the body: **"Lessons"**. That word is the whole of the request, and it had been waiting twenty-three days.
**Pairs with:** DR-0312 (the forwarded-teaching intake), DR-0610 (the capture lock), DR-1126 (the third pile is a worklist, and it is counted), DR-0108 (the team's reach, not one agent's), DR-0076 (§1 evidence, §3 proven-to-catch, §4 measure don't claim, §8 provenance and honest uncertainty), DR-0098 (teach the Word, do not debate it), DR-0100 (established fact plainly; the open flagged narrowly), DR-0210 (Yahweh in our voice, never substituted into a quotation), DR-0459 (never an elision), DR-0811 (a true story names whose life it was), DR-0733 / DR-0795 (every band sends the reader all three ways), DR-0734 (`anchor.ref` names every verse the lesson stands on), DR-0697 (new work meets the four-band standard at once), DR-0501 (the capstone course), DR-0696 (its four bands), DR-0239 (a surface says true things), DR-0075 (nothing parked without a why and a date)

## Context

Management Is Stewardship shipped as the capstone of the Real Estate department with an eight-move argument that closes on the reckoning: faithful is the metric and it is taken at the least; entrusted by ability and judged by action; a very little produces ten cities; the manager his owner stopped checking; the battlement owed to a stranger; the portion in due season; restitution with a date; and the account given with joy or with grief.

The forward put a question to that course which it had never answered, and which arrives **before** lesson one rather than after lesson eight: **who sets the standard a steward is measured by, when nobody above him has written one?**

**The material is material, never an instruction.** A SmartBrief issue is a column of other outlets' headline summaries with sponsor placements set between them. That edition carried eleven such items — a campus gift, a privately funded academy, a student-visa appeal, a tuition lawsuit, a cadet-corps designation, closed campuses as housing, a podcast on enrolment, a cell-biology diversion, three ICYMI links, an awards deadline and a quiz — plus three advertisements and a free-eBook block. **One** item is germane. None of the advertising is taught, and a check in the pinned gate refuses twenty-one of those names a foothold in any string of the module.

## What was measured

**The source, and its exact standing.** The germane item is the "What's on Your Mind?" guest column, introduced by the digest's editor and reproduced in part. Its author is **Mara Woody**, who signs herself Red, Director of Strategic Partnerships at **Riipen**. She reports a remark made at a conference she was sitting in: employers are asking higher education to develop **AI literacy and AI fluency**, and the problem is that **employers do not really know what AI literacy is either**. The room nodded; she did not. Her question, which is the hinge of the lesson, is why anybody waits for somebody else to define the future before deciding what his own part in making it ought to be. She adds a claim about her sector — that higher education did not simply react to history, it helped shape it — and credits a historian she names and a policy conference she attended. The lesson relays all of that as **hers**, not as ours, on every reader-facing surface.

**The material is genuinely thin, and the lesson says so rather than inflating it.** One column, reproduced in part, carrying a reported remark, a question and a claim. That is the whole of the germane content, and the lesson is built on one sentence of it rather than pretending the issue contained an argument it did not.

**WHAT WAS NOT VERIFIED, stated plainly (DR-0076 §8), and said on every reader-facing surface.** The newsletter is the only source for every claim about the column. **The full column behind its link was never opened** — the forward carried the digest and its links were never followed. Nobody telephoned SmartBrief, Riipen, Ms Woody, the historian she names or the policy conference she refers to, and nobody here has independently verified that any of them said what the edition reports. The adult text **and all four bands** say so. The gate makes each disclosure non-removable with a pin proven **unique to its own place** — five differently worded sentences, one per reader text, each asserted to occur in exactly one of the five — and a proven-to-catch case deletes the teen band's and watches the check go red.

**THE PIN-UNIQUENESS CHECK EXISTS BECAUSE OF A SIBLING'S MEASURED FAILURE, not out of caution.** DR-1275 pinned the bare token `367,000` and the strip proof stayed green with the disclosure deleted, because that figure also sat in the lesson body; DR-1278 pinned the bare name `Mitch Berk` and the same thing happened, because every band named him a second time inside its own disclosure passage. So no pin in this gate is trusted until the test itself has asserted that the phrase occurs in exactly one reader text and that it is the expected one. That is a check on the checks, written from two recorded failures rather than from a hunch.

**AND THE ROAD, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED SHUT (DR-0108).** `lesson-sources.json` exists so that a GitHub runner reads a **figure** back off a publisher's own page, and a runner reaches hosts this sandbox cannot — DR-1275 proved that on `federalreserve.gov`. What a runner has no input for here is a probe: **this lesson stakes no figure.** The germane column prints no statistic at all. Every number in that edition belongs to a different story — a two-billion-dollar campus gift, a forty-two-million-dollar academy, a 3.7-million-home shortfall — or to the sponsor copy, and none of it is germane or taught. A row for mgmt9 would therefore necessarily be a **0-figure row**, which makes `checked()` count a lesson whose figures nobody read: the anti-theatre rule in DR-0076 §3. There is no candidate `says` string that could be written without inventing one.

The lesson therefore takes the second branch `the-third-pile-is-a-worklist` offers — say plainly why it cannot be checked — and **GAP rises 13 → 14** with that reason and `re-review: 2026-11-29`. `CHECKED_LESSONS` stays 2. The lesson also says the positive half out loud, so no reader is left guessing which number is soft: *this lesson stakes no figure*, and the gate pins that claim by requiring that **no reader text carries a currency symbol, a percentage, or a number wearing a magnitude word** — written as the three shapes a figure-claim takes rather than as "no digits", because a date and a verse reference are numbers and are not figures. Proven by planting `$2 billion` in the youth band and by planting `37%`, which a currency-only check would have missed.

**The three tiers (DR-0100), because this subject is exactly where hedging happens.** ESTABLISHED, and stated flat with no hedge near it: by the column's own report, the parties demanding the standard said they do not hold one. That is what the source says and the lesson says it plainly rather than as "some suggest". Also established, and the operational half: a steward who declines to set a standard has not escaped one — he is governed by the standard of whoever did not wait. OPEN, narrowly and once: **what AI literacy will come to mean is unsettled, and nobody here knows.** That is the only thing flagged, and it is not smeared into a general doubt about preparing people for work. NOT claimed anywhere: that this lesson knows what any employer, college or policy body should do.

**DR-0098 IS LOAD-BEARING HERE, and the lesson says so in its own text.** Education policy is a camps subject, and the easy failure would have been three human schools set side by side with the reader invited to choose and that called balance. The lesson refuses it in writing — *this house does not stage camps* — and the gate requires that sentence, requires *we teach what the Word shows and stop where the Word is silent*, and requires the youth, teen and senior bands each to carry their own refusal of the both-sides posture in their own register.

**The Word, which was on this subject first, and the spine was chosen by COUNTING rather than by theme.** The capstone's own rule is that it must not re-preach the department's footing, so every candidate was checked against both courses' anchors before it was written. The eight chapters this lesson stands on — **Proverbs 6, 1 Thessalonians 4, Ecclesiastes 9, Exodus 31, Exodus 35, 1 Chronicles 12, 2 Timothy 2, Proverbs 12** — appear in **no anchor of mgmt1 to mgmt8 and in none of the footing course's**, and the gate asserts both directions rather than trusting the claim. Two obvious candidates were **declined by measurement**: `Proverbs 22:29` (*a man diligent in his business shall stand before kings*) and `Proverbs 27:17` (*iron sharpeneth iron*, the house's usual friend-prompt verse) both sit in chapters the footing course already holds, so neither could be used and the friend prompt in every band is written without a verse rather than with a borrowed chapter.

The ant is the argument. *"Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:"* (Proverbs 6:6), and then the clause that does the work: *"Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,"* (Proverbs 6:7) — no instruction, no inspection, no published standard — and the outcome is nevertheless provision in the right season: *"Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest."* (Proverbs 6:8). The absence of a definition from above is not a licence; it is the ordinary condition of a creature expected to work regardless. Then the charge, which preceded the market: *"your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;"* (1 Thessalonians 4:11) — **already commanded** — reaching whatever is to hand, *"Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might;"* (Ecclesiastes 9:10). Then what preparing a worker actually takes, in four parts where a training scheme usually stops at two: skill is provision with a name attached, *"in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,"* (Exodus 31:3); the transmissible half is provision too, He *"put in his heart that he may teach"* (Exodus 35:34), so a competent worker who cannot hand his competence on is half finished; the hour is read **in order to act**, men who *"had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do;"* (1 Chronicles 12:32); and the chain runs four hands deep with both adjectives load-bearing, *"to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also."* (2 Timothy 2:2) — faithful is this course's own metric from lesson one, and able to teach others also is the examination. And who ends up holding the pen: *"The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute."* (Proverbs 12:24).

**The verbatim sweep, measured twice by two different parsers.** The gate pairs quotations by splitting on the quote character; the record's number comes from an **independent regex sweep** run separately, so the figure here was not produced by the code the gate uses (the failure DR-1276's sibling recorded, where expectation and implementation moved together and a rewrite stayed green with the filter deleted). **56 referenced quoted spans across the whole module, 56 verbatim, 0 faults, 0 double-quoted spans anywhere in the module that are not the Word with its reference beside it, 12 distinct references, exactly the 12 `anchor.ref` carries.** No ellipsis inside any quotation. No generic "God" and no "the LORD" in our own voice anywhere, while the KJV's own "God" inside Exodus 31:3 is untouched. No decision-record id and no thread id where a reader can see it.

**The lesson, measured on the module rather than claimed.** Adult prose **1,247 words**; band shares **child 0.59 / youth 0.65 / teen 0.70 / senior 0.65** against floors 0.50 / 0.60 / 0.60 / 0.60; reading ladder **1.4 / 2.5 / 4.3 / 6.1**, strictly ascending, child under the 5.0 new-lesson ceiling and teen under this course's own 6.0 teen ceiling; worst band-pair overlap **0.11** against the 0.50 differentiation ceiling and the course's tighter 0.25 near-copy line, worst pair including the adult text **0.12**; title named in the opening of all four bands; numbered headings **contiguous 1 to 12**; no hard term used before its plain meaning; every band renders without losing a word. Two **parables** on this lesson's own spine — a firm that waited for the trade body's guidance, and a page taped inside a cupboard door.

**BOTH STORIES ARE PARABLES, IN THE THIRD PERSON, and that was a decision rather than a default.** A lesson built from a newsletter has nobody's life in it. `story-truth.js` renders a `kind: 'testimony'` with a footnote that says *"A true story: this happened, told with the person's consent"* — substituting "the person's" when no source is named — so an invented narrator labelled testimony tells the reader a real person lived it and consented, while the data records neither. That is the defect DR-0811 counted at 88 shipped blocks. The gate asserts both stories are parables, that neither carries a `source`, and that neither slips into the first person.

**THE GATE FOUND THREE THINGS THE AUTHOR DID NOT.** Recorded because a record listing only what went right is the theatre DR-0076 forbids.

1. **Three band shares were below their floors on the first measurement** — child 0.46, youth 0.54, teen 0.56 — because the adult lesson had grown to 1,247 prose words. Fixed the right way round, as DR-1278 did: the three bands gained real material they were missing (Issachar, Proverbs 12:24 and the four-hands-deep chain in child; the diligent hand, the one-page practice and the no-camps method in youth; the one-page practice and the DR-0100 tier handling in teen), rather than cutting adult teaching to flatter a ratio.
2. **The reading ladder was INVERTED between youth and teen** — youth 4.8 against teen 4.0 — which no amount of reading the prose would have revealed, because both bands read fluently and the fault is only visible as two numbers side by side. The youth band's sentences were shortened until it read at 2.5.
3. **The senior band read at grade 11.0, over this course's 10.0 ceiling.** Its long em-dashed sentences were split into shorter ones; it now reads 6.1, which is still clearly above the teen band and comfortably inside the ceiling.

**Proven-to-catch, on the live artifact and not only on an in-test fixture (DR-0076 §3).** Seventeen deliberate breaks, applied one at a time, run, and restored: a word altered inside Proverbs 6:7; a verbatim span hung on Proverbs 6:8 instead of 6:7; a typographic apostrophe replaced with a straight one in a corpus span from the same shelf; the disclosure deleted from the teen band; `$2 billion` planted in the youth band; `37%` planted, which a currency-only check would miss; another story's name (Ken Griffin) reaching the teaching; the child band's friend line removed, which leaves `hasAllThree` green and must still be named by band; the youth band's title opening replaced; the teen band cut to a four-sentence stub; the youth band replaced by the teen band; an anchor reference the lesson never names; a chapter borrowed back from the footing course; a generic "God" dropped into our prose; a `testimony` label on an invented story; the second story removed; and the senior band's elder-direction wording checked to count rather than assumed.

## Decision

Ship mgmt9 as the ninth lesson of Management Is Stewardship, with all four age bands from its first commit, its own pinned gate, and its honest limit on the lesson and on every band. The eight-move arc still closes at mgmt8: this lesson is **appended**, because the question it answers arrives before lesson one and was asked by a forwarded word rather than by the outline, and the course header says so in its own arc comment. Raise the counted honesty gap from 13 to 14 with the reason above and `re-review: 2026-11-29`, rather than write a 0-figure source row that would make the ledger claim a reading nobody performed.

- `app/src/lib/management-stewardship-course.js` — mgmt9 added; `META.weeks` 8 → 9 and `META.format` "8 lessons" → "9 lessons", both following the module count; the arc comment names the ninth move and why it is appended; the tutor blurb now names nine principles.
- `app/src/__tests__/management-stewardship-mgmt9-verses.test.js` — new, the lesson's own gate.
- `app/src/__tests__/management-stewardship-course.test.js` — the module list gains mgmt9; the schedule-length and progress-total assertions are now **derived from the module list** rather than re-pinned by hand, so the next lesson does not have to edit two numbers to say one thing (DR-0677's shape).
- `app/src/__tests__/the-third-pile-is-a-worklist.test.js` — `GAP` 13 → 14 with its reason and date.

## Honest limits, and one improvement declined with a date

- **The full column was never opened and nobody was telephoned.** That is the whole of the unchecked material, it is named on five reader surfaces, and it is counted in the gap above with a date.
- **No figure is staked, so none can be wrong** — but equally, this lesson adds no verified number to the house. The gap entry is the honest record of that, not a boast.
- **DECLINED, with a why and a date (DR-0075):** every one of the house's catalog courses ends its `meta.blurb` with *"Free, in full, every lesson at two reading levels"*, and all of them now carry four. It is one stale sentence repeated across more than a dozen course files, so fixing it in this course alone would make the shelf inconsistent and fixing it everywhere is outside an additive curriculum change and would touch files this lesson has no business in. `re-review: 2026-11-29` — sweep the phrase across every `meta.blurb` in one change, in the same pass that re-reviews the gap entry above.

## Verification

- `npm run lint` — exit 0.
- `npm run verify:gates` — exit 0, including `lesson-dates:check` and `one-teaching-one-lesson-guard`.
- The lesson's own gate, the course's gate, `the-third-pile-is-a-worklist`, `course-band-coverage`, `talk-together`, `the-plain-meaning-comes-first`, `a-true-story-names-whose-life-it-was`, `lesson-completeness`, `lesson-dates`, `decision-chain` and `the-pointer-line-stops-doubling` all green; the full suite via CI's four `--shard=i/4` legs, whose union is the suite (a local full run measured at hours on this box and the machine's two vitest slots were held by sibling builders for most of this session).

## Re-review

`re-review: 2026-11-29` — from a runner with web access, open the full guest column behind the forward's link. If its body carries a germane figure this lesson should teach, teach it, give mgmt9 a row in `lesson-sources.json` and lower the gap pin to 13. If the column prints no figure either, replace the "did not open the full column" clause with an accurate one and lower the pin. Sweep the stale "two reading levels" blurb line in the same pass.

## A note on the number

This record is DR-1281, not DR-1279 or DR-1280. `INDEX.md` pointed at **DR-1279**, which is all a file can know, and it was not free: **PR #2482** (`bank9: the moat that moves`) held it and merged to `main` while this branch was building. **DR-1280** is held by **PR #2464** (`money/phase-2-safe-to-spend`, carrying the `hold` label), and a sibling lesson branch in flight on world-market was also working that number — which is the DR-1021 condition, two holders a repo-reading tool cannot see. Both holders above were read off the live pull-request list rather than assumed, because a record that names the wrong holder is worse than one that names none (DR-0239).
